scenes: How many people did the heat kill?
The honest answer is: we often don’t know. | Death certificates record the immediate cause, like a heart attack, | not the heat that triggered it.
In India in 2024, a hundred and eighty-five heatstroke deaths were confirmed, | against more than forty-eight thousand suspected heatstroke cases.
Counting excess deaths, above the normal for that time of year, shows the fuller toll.
What isn’t counted is hard to plan for.
